title: Weekend Plans
plot: A woman in her thirties is dumped by her boyfriend a week before her sister's wedding and has to decide whether to bring a date, while her family argues about the seating plan and her best friend tries to set her up with a coworker.

title: The Letters from Kiyosato
plot: In a small mountain town in Japan, two childhood friends are separated when one family moves to Tokyo. For fifteen years they write each other letters, through school, first jobs and the death of a grandmother, never quite saying what they feel. When the old railway line between their towns is about to close, the young woman takes the last train back to the station where they said goodbye, not knowing whether he will be there. An animated film about distance, memory, the seasons and the people we leave behind.

title: Grandfather's Orchard
plot: After her father dies, a ten-year-old girl from Seoul spends a summer with her silent grandfather on his apple orchard in the countryside. He teaches her to graft trees, to cook and to listen to the rain, while slowly revealing the story of the family he lost in the Korean War. As the harvest comes and the city wants to buy his land, the girl and the old man find in each other the family they both thought was gone, in a quiet, tender drama about grief and inheritance.

title: The Ferryman's Daughter
plot: In 1950s rural Japan, the daughter of a ferryman who carries villagers across a wide river grows up watching the people who cross: soldiers returning from the war, brides, a traveling doctor, a boy who never comes back. When a dam is planned upstream that will end the ferry and drown the village, she must decide whether to leave for the city or stay with her aging father for the last season. Told across the four seasons of one year, a gentle film about memory, family and the passing of a way of life.

title: Guardians of the Ark
plot: A team of superheroes with powers drawn from ancient legends must unite when a cosmic tyrant returns to Earth to seize an ancient relic hidden since biblical times. Led by a reluctant hero who discovers he is the last descendant of a warrior bloodline, the heroes battle across New York, Cairo and the heavens as a giant monster rises from the sea. With the fate of the universe at stake, they must put aside their differences and sacrifice everything in an epic final battle to save the world.

title: The Snow Kingdom
plot: A young princess with magical ice powers runs away from her kingdom on Christmas Eve after accidentally freezing her father's castle. With the help of a talking reindeer, a clumsy elf and a brave orphan boy, she journeys to the North Pole to find Santa Claus, the only one who can teach her to control her magic. Pursued by an evil sorcerer who wants her power, she must learn to believe in herself and save Christmas for the whole world in an animated musical adventure for the whole family.

title: Titan Rising
plot: When a colossal ancient monster awakens beneath the Pacific and destroys Tokyo, the world's last line of defense is a secret team of genetically enhanced soldiers and their giant robot. A brilliant scientist discovers that the creature is the first of an army of titans, and that the only weapon that can stop them is hidden inside a lost temple. As the monsters converge on San Francisco, the heroes must team up with an unlikely ally, the king of the monsters, in a spectacular battle for the survival of humanity.

title: The Lantern Spirit
plot: In a small village in the mountains of Japan, a lonely girl who has just lost her mother befriends a gentle forest spirit who carries a lantern. When an ancient demon awakens and darkness spreads across the land, the spirit gives her the power to become a guardian, and the girl must journey through magical kingdoms, gather friends and face the demon to save her village and the spirit world. An animated adventure about grief, courage and friendship.

title: The Last Spell
plot: A young wizard who has spent his life hiding his powers is drawn into an ancient war between kingdoms of magic when his little sister is taken by a dark sorceress. With a band of misfit heroes, a dragon and his late mother's book of spells, he crosses enchanted forests and frozen mountains to save her, learning that his family's secret is the key to defeating the darkness and saving the world. A heartfelt fantasy adventure about family, sacrifice and growing up.

title: Last Stand of the Vanguard
plot: When an alien warlord armed with six cosmic stones invades Earth, the surviving members of the Vanguard, the planet's mightiest superheroes, must reunite for one final mission. A billionaire inventor in an armored suit, a super-soldier out of time, a god of thunder and a young hero from Queens travel across space and through time to undo the warlord's destruction. Their battle ends in a war over a ruined New York, where every hero who ever fought beside them returns, and one of them must sacrifice everything to save the universe.

title: The Cipher
plot: Based on the true story of the brilliant, awkward mathematician who led a secret team of codebreakers in the Second World War. Recruited by British intelligence, he builds a machine to crack the enemy's unbreakable code while hiding his own secret from a society that would imprison him for it. As the war turns on his work, he must race against time, his superiors and his own mind, in a moving portrait of genius, sacrifice and the price of being different.

title: The Academy of Lost Stars
plot: On his eleventh birthday, an orphan boy living with his cruel aunt learns that he is the son of two legendary sorcerers and is invited to a hidden academy of magic in a castle in the mountains. There he makes his first real friends, learns spells, plays a dangerous flying sport and discovers that the dark lord who killed his parents is trying to return. As the school year ends, the boy and his friends must pass through a series of enchanted trials beneath the castle to stop him.

title: Nightwatch
plot: A billionaire who saw his parents murdered as a boy patrols his corrupt city at night as a masked vigilante. When a chaotic criminal mastermind begins a campaign of terror designed to prove that anyone can be corrupted, the vigilante, an honest district attorney and the city's last good police commissioner are pushed to their limits. As the city descends into anarchy, the hero must decide how far he will go, and whether the city needs a hero or a villain to blame, in a dark and gripping crime epic.

title: Wings of the Morning
plot: Based on the true story of a young farm boy from Texas who becomes a fighter pilot in the Second World War. Shot down over the Pacific, he survives forty days on a raft with two crewmates, holding on to his faith and his Bible as sharks circle and storms rage. Rescued by a Navy submarine, he returns to fly again in the greatest air battle of the war, and comes home to the girl who waited for him, in an inspiring story of courage, faith and survival.

title: The Ten Rings of Jade
plot: A young martial artist working as a valet in San Francisco is drawn into the world of his father, the immortal leader of an ancient secret society who wields ten mystical rings of power. Joined by his estranged sister and his best friend, he travels to a hidden village of dragons and legendary creatures, and must master his powers to stop his father from unleashing an army of soul-eating demons and save the world, in an action-packed superhero adventure.

title: Skyfall Earth
plot: When a massive solar storm knocks out every satellite and power grid on Earth, triggering superstorms, tsunamis and a new ice age, a NASA climatologist must lead a desperate mission to space to save humanity. Meanwhile his teenage daughter is trapped in a frozen New York, fighting to survive with a group of strangers. As the President orders the evacuation of the northern hemisphere, father and daughter race against time to find each other before the world freezes over.

title: Space Pup
plot: In this animated adventure, a scrappy little dog who dreams of being a hero sneaks aboard a rocket and is accidentally launched into outer space. Stranded on a planet of talking alien animals, he discovers he has super powers and teams up with a nervous space hamster and a grumpy robot cat to stop an evil emperor from destroying Earth, and to find his way home to the boy who loves him, in a funny, heartwarming family comedy.

title: Laika
plot: Based on the true story of the little stray dog from the streets of Moscow who became the first living creature to orbit the Earth. In this animated film, a scrappy, curious stray is picked up by Soviet scientists in 1957 and trained for the space program alongside other dogs, cared for by a young lab technician who comes to love her. As the launch approaches and the Cold War space race demands a triumph, the technician must face the truth about the mission, in a moving story of friendship, sacrifice and the dream of the stars.

title: The Girl Who Flew
plot: Based on the true story of a Japanese girl from a small fishing village who dreamed of flying. In the 1930s, defying her father and her country's traditions, she teaches herself to build gliders from bamboo and silk, and becomes the first woman in Japan to earn a pilot's license. When the war comes and the military wants her as a test pilot, she must choose between her dream of the sky and her refusal to fly for war, in an animated film about courage, family and freedom.
